mainEntity.name: What tools or methods are used in Customer Query Research for AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Customer Query Research utilizes a combination of tools and methods. These include analyzing 'People Also Ask' sections in search results, reviewing customer support inquiries, using competitor analysis to see what questions they answer, and employing specialized SEO tools that track long-tail keywords and question-based queries. Voice search data and natural language processing (NLP) insights are also crucial for uncovering how users phrase their questions conversationally. Manual review of search results and forums further refines understanding.
